newsitem.title: CHINA: China rejects dissident Wang Dan appeal - family.
newsitem.headline: China rejects dissident Wang Dan appeal - family.

text.p: A Chinese court on Friday rejected the appeal of dissident Wang Dan and upheld an 11-year prison term for plotting to overthrow the government, family members told Reuters.
They told Reuters that the hearing lasted 10 minutes and no one was permitted to speak except for the judge who read from a prepared statement.
"It was all prepared in advance ... It was very unfair," said the dissident's mother Wang Lingyun.

The family also staged a one hour sit-in protest in front of the court building but apparently out of view from reporters. Police earlier kept reporters away from the court building, the family's home and a nearby subway station.
Wang, a former student leader, had already served four years in prison for his role in student demonstrations for democracy that were crushed by the military in 1989.
